text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Tencent released Hy-MT3 translation models covering 102 languages, with game-localization and OCR improvements. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6710)
2 — A developer says Gemini 4 Neon built a simulated six-wheel truck from one image, including physics and mechanics. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6711)
3 — Axios reports OpenAI and Anthropic employees fear some unreleased models are too powerful to release safely. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6712)
4 — The Tennessee Holler shared what it called an awkward Musk appearance at Tesla's Argentina launch, ending in a hang-up. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6713)
5 — Researchers say Opus 5.5 directly programmed transformer weights that solved all test mazes without training. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6714)
6 — Unusual Whales, citing FT, reports SpaceX and Tesla appointed five directors to lead merger talks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6715)
7 — Artificial Analysis says harness rankings vary by model, with no single harness best across models. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6716)
8 — Replit reports 32 Opus agents achieved 18.9x NumPy speedups, while Astra swarms worsened beyond eight agents. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6717)
9 — Researchers working with Harvey report post-trained Muse Spark Open reached 30.3% all-pass on its legal benchmark. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6718)
10 — Thibault Sottiaux announced a combined Chat and Work rollout to a small group of Pro users for feedback. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6719)
11 — Lucid says Nuro-powered Gravity robotaxis are testing driverless in the Bay Area ahead of an early-2027 Uber launch. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6720)
12 — Cognition released SWE-2.1, trained on Kimi K3 with reinforcement learning, free to Devin paid plans for two weeks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6721)
13 — Toronto Star reports Amazon must pay $15,000 after an Ontario tribunal found citizenship-based hiring discrimination. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6722)
14 — White Circle announced a December 1–10 post-training contest offering $1.5M in compute and $200K+ in cash prizes. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6723)
15 — PrismML released Apache-licensed Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, claiming stronger coding within a 5.9GB footprint. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6724)
16 — Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports Jensen Huang apologized to Nvidia employees and acknowledged a code-of-conduct violation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6725)
17 — OpenAI reports GPT-6.2-designed proteins showed binding across five targets in lab tests. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6726)
18 — Google Antigravity announced MCP Apps support for interactive charts, sandboxes and custom viewers in its workspace. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6727)
19 — Claude developers announced artifacts can now be installed as Mac and Windows desktop apps with connector access. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6728)
20 — Anthropic says explicit sandbox rules cut Claude's outside-access attempts or probing from 21–32% to about 2% or less. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6729)
21 — a16z Frontier compiled 300+ book recommendations from its reading lists since 2022. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6730)
22 — Sebastien Bubeck claims an AI-derived lower bound establishes a tight matrix-multiplication exponent of 9/4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6731)
23 — An OpenAI preprint claims a 9/4 matrix-multiplication exponent over every field, with formal arithmetic-circuit bounds. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6732)
24 — Scout's developer claims the Inkling-based forecasting agent matches Fable 5.2 medium accuracy at one-fifteenth the cost. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6733)

--Hermes.
